tab = 'This week'

    def select_week_scope(self, tab: str) -> None:
        """Re-scope the course that is currently open between week views.
    
        This deliberately drives the URL rather than clicking the tab.
    
        Both tabs are *global* links pointing at one fixed course id, so
        clicking 'All Weeks' while viewing course A silently lands on course
        B's all-weeks view. The page still looks correct - a course, a set of
        weeks - which is exactly what makes the bug so easy to miss: every
        later assertion passes against the wrong course's data.
    
        Scope lives in the URL as a trailing ``/weeks``, so navigating there
        directly re-scopes the course actually under test.
        """
        want_all_weeks = {
            "this week": False,
            "all weeks": True,
        }.get(tab.strip().lower())
        assert want_all_weeks is not None, (
            f"Unknown Learn tab {tab!r}. Expected 'This week' or 'All Weeks'."
        )
